_doc: #1469 THE declaration of Media's playlist sources, read by assets/media-sync.js (parser, runner, mappers) and by Configs (the Music / Videos / Gallery tabs, Apify | Direct subsections). One row per service: `method` is the default, `methods` what it may be switched to in Configs. direct = the service's official API with the owner's own token (Spotify Web API, YouTube Data API, Deezer public API); apify = an Apify actor named by `actor`, run through the chosen backend (Apify Cloud by default, self-hosted Cloudy Crawlee opt-in; the `apify` block below is the shared libs/apify declaration), with `input` as its run input where {ref} is the profile, playlist or board URL the owner enters. Actor ids are defaults the owner can change. Metadata only: titles, artists, ISRC, covers and links; nothing here fetches audio or video, and no DRM is touched.

apify._doc: Same shape as the shared libs/apify declaration (#1470, ApifyBackends.parse): Apify Cloud is the default, self-hosted Cloudy Crawlee is opt-in; both speak the Apify API (acts/<user~name>/run-sync-get-dataset-items, bearer). Store keys as the shared store: apify.backend, apify.token (cloud), apify.self.bearer and apify.self.url (self-hosted).

sources.label: Spotify playlists
sources.token_help: OAuth access token with playlist-read-private (Spotify Web API); kept encrypted.

sources.label: YouTube playlists
sources.token_help: OAuth access token with youtube.readonly (YouTube Data API v3); kept encrypted.

sources.label: Deezer playlists
sources.token_help: Public playlists need no token; the ref is the Deezer user id. The Deezer API sends no CORS headers, so a webview may refuse it; apify is the default.
sources.ref_label: Deezer user id (direct) or profile URL (apify)

app_pages._doc: Static text of Configs > Perms and Configs > About (the app is a webview, so the shared native pages are summarised here; the full ones open from the fleet menu).

perms.name: Internet
perms.why: Sync calls the Spotify Web API, the YouTube Data API, Deezer and Apify (Cloud or your Cloudy Crawlee) with your own tokens.

perms.name: Nothing else
perms.why: No storage, contacts or location grant is asked; tokens stay encrypted in the app's own storage.

about: Cloud Media Center keeps the owner's music, video and image playlists in one library.
Sync reads metadata only (titles, artists, ISRC, covers, links). No audio or video is downloaded and no DRM is touched.

Direct sources use the official APIs with your own token; Apify sources run an actor on the backend chosen in the Apify tab (Apify Cloud by default, self-hosted Cloudy Crawlee opt-in; the `apify` block below is the shared libs/apify declaration).
Music is matched against the collection by ISRC, then by title, artist and length, as in Cloud Browser.
